title: Holding statement / full statement
description: A public statement on organization letterhead. The default variant is a holding statement: the first public words, short (under 150 words), with what is known, what is not yet known and what is being done, when the next update comes and a media contact. The full variant is a complete statement with a body. The organization, people and outlets are fictional.

orgAddress.description: Address or web line under the organization name

kindLabel.description: Document label at the top right

issuedAt.description: Date and time of issue with time zone, consistent with the exercise clock

headline.description: Statement headline, sentence case, plain words
examples: Halyard Components is investigating unauthorized access to a company system

known.description: What is known now: short, confirmed facts only (holding statement)
examples: On Tuesday morning our security team detected unauthorized access to a file server.

notKnown.description: What is not yet known: say so plainly (holding statement)
examples: We have not determined whether customer information was affected.

beingDone.description: What the organization is doing now (holding statement)
examples: We isolated the affected server and engaged outside forensic specialists.

body.description: Full statement text, blank lines between paragraphs (full variant)

quote.description: Optional quote from the spokesperson, attributed in speakerName
examples: Our priority is protecting our customers and employees.
Dana Whitfield, Vice President of Communications

nextUpdate.description: When the next update will be issued
examples: We will provide another update by 6:00 PM ET today.

approvedBy.description: Who approved release (shown small in the footer)
examples: Approved for release: General Counsel and CEO, 3:05 PM ET
